name: Lumen Arc Reactive Moto Jacket
description:
A motorcycle jacket that glows — or rather, one that can. The Lumen Arc is built on a standard moto chassis: pre-curved arms, asymmetric front zip, snap-down collar, CE-rated impact protection at shoulders and elbows. The exterior is a matte black synth-leather with embedded electroluminescent thread woven in circuit-like patterns across the shoulders, sleeves, and back panel. At rest, the patterns are subtle — slightly raised lines you'd mistake for decorative stitching. Activated, they pulse in cool white or amber, drawing the eye from fifty meters.

Lumen Arc is a Tier 2 to 3 street brand that started as a custom shop for courier cyclists and expanded when their light-up designs went viral in underground racing circles. The jacket is popular with night-shift couriers for visibility, with club-goers for aesthetics, and with anyone who thinks looking dangerous and being seen are not mutually exclusive goals.
functionality: Embedded electroluminescent thread activated by pressure toggle at inner cuff. Visible from 50+ meters. Draws on small integrated battery lasting approximately 8 hours per charge.
what_it_says: You move fast at night and you want people to know you're coming.
story_hooks: A Lumen Arc jacket's light pattern was caught on surveillance footage during a high-profile theft — the pattern is distinctive enough to identify the jacket's specific production batch.
The electroluminescent thread in a recent production run is responding to an external signal source, causing jackets to activate without user input near a specific city block.
An underground courier race requires all participants to wear Lumen Arc jackets — someone has sabotaged one jacket's battery to overheat under sustained use.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek moto jacket with aggressive, functional silhouette. Tapered at the waist, broad through shoulders. Asymmetric front creates dynamic visual tension. At rest, appears as premium black leather with subtle textured paneling. When activated, luminous circuit patterns ignite across shoulders, sleeves, and spine — transforming the wearer into a moving light source.
physical_description.fit: Tailored through torso with pre-curved sleeves for riding position. Fitted at waist, relaxed enough for layering. Movement-optimized — not fashion-forward slim, not oversized. Built for function without sacrificing silhouette.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte black synth-leather (petroleum-resistant, temperature-adaptive). Electroluminescent thread embedded in structural weave. Reinforced ballistic panels at impact zones.
physical_description.texture: Smooth synth-leather surface with raised circuit-line texture from embedded EL thread. Slightly quilted at shoulder/elbow protection zones. Matte finish absorbs light when dark; thread creates subtle topography.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep matte black base. Electroluminescent patterns in cool white or amber (user-switchable). Subtle grey contrast stitching on seams and collar.
physical_description.closures: Asymmetric front zipper (brushed steel pull, YKK industrial grade). Snap-down collar with reinforced rivets. Wrist zippers with friction-fit cuffs.
distinctive_features: Embedded electroluminescent thread in circuit-board aesthetic
Pulse/glow activation via subdermal QUANTA chip interface
CE-rated impact armor (shoulders, elbows) — visible as raised panels
Lumen Arc branding on left sleeve (stylized circuit loop)
Hidden inner pockets (RFID-lined for courier use)
Reinforced seams at stress points — visible as double stitching
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover. Premium materials and embedded tech push toward Tier 2, but street-brand origin and courier functionality ground it firmly in working-class tier 3 accessibility.
physical_description.cultural_context: Night-shift courier culture. Underground racing crews. Club-goers prioritizing visibility and aesthetic. Anyone who needs to be seen and wants to project controlled danger. Not corpo (too aggressive), not sub-grade (too refined).
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new with activation. Breaks in quickly — creases form at elbows and shoulders. Light scuffing on synth-leather from courier work. EL threads remain bright for 2-3 years before dimming slightly.
